sourceReview: Both actual upstream checker entry points accept opts plus jepsen.history/history operations at the fixed commit.
Explicit serializable options and the upstream additional-graphs assertion avoid automatic process/realtime graphs. No transaction-order is supplied.
Register nil renaming is per key and restricted to at most one actual write per key. No initializer transaction or searched key order becomes a source fact.

List empty initialization, globally unique append identities and exact original business payload checks preserve the declared first shared range. A duplicate observed identity reaches the real checker as an anomaly candidate.
Unknown source, nonempty list initialization and unsupported lifecycle are excluded before checker invocation; they are not counted as checker passes.
The actual upstream result is preserved as EDN. Edgeless-graph unknowns remain coverage differences, not Boolean agreement.

SDK module copying includes its current core, capture-core and evidence imports. Source identity must additionally be enforced by the enclosing runner, not inferred from a self-consistent mutable build manifest.
preExecutionRequirements: Keep all original 15 smoke inputs and expectations unchanged; an early positive failure must prevent interpreting negative rejections as successful validator coverage.
Enforce the b6638ee56395a14284d1440a92a0d975c4ea4073f42ccab6d8d39e359d928096 source fingerprint before and after build, and bind actual SDK, manifest, core and capture bytes.

Verify the fixed standalone Leiningen JAR SHA256 and actual Clojure 1.12.6 runtime. Keep all resolved JAR/POM hashes and dependency tree; their transitive license inventory is pending real resolution.
Retain the separate complete Leiningen COPYING file alongside the copied launcher, in addition to the different Elle LICENSE. Do not relabel either source collection as the production Apache license.
Any absent host JDK21 location, dependency bootstrap failure, timeout or exception is a setup/execution failure with a retained receipt, not an Elle unknown result.

leinLicense.scope: Upstream COPYING identifies source EPL1.0 and includes its separate documentation terms. This is a source notice inventory, not a claim that dependency licenses have all been independently reviewed.

limitations: This review is not independent actual checker acceptance and does not establish Clojure syntax/runtime success.
The workflow and runner were being edited by the parent; they require their own final frozen binding and real execution evidence.
The all-committed single-writer/empty-list profile is narrower than either tool's full support. No six-model, arbitrary SQL, database or performance claim follows.
